meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求修复某个 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的 bug 时,Claude 会先复现问题、定位原因,做出最小修复并测试。属于上游 Codex 的问题会以拉取请求(PR)提交;属于 LazyCodex 的问题会在其仓库创建带补丁的 issue,绝不直接改仓库。
howto.when: 当你说要修复 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的 bug、为某个缺陷提交修复、开 PR 等时触发。

say.text: 帮我修复 LazyCodex 的安装报错 bug,附上日志。
say.note: Claude 会复现问题并创建带补丁的 issue。

say.text: 这个 openai/codex 的 bug 请修复并开 PR。
say.note: 会创建 fork PR 并附验证日志。

say.text: 修复这个 bug,并把补丁提交到正确仓库。
say.note: 会先判断归属,再决定开 PR 还是 issue。

howto.what_en: When asked to fix a LazyCodex or Codex bug, Claude reproduces it, finds the root cause, implements and tests the smallest fix. Upstream openai/codex gets a fork PR; LazyCodex-owned defects get a verified-fix issue with the patch on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex bug for me, logs attached.
say_en.note: Claude will reproduce and file a patch issue.

say_en.text: Please fix this openai/codex bug and open a PR.
say_en.note: It will create a fork PR with verification.

say_en.text: Fix this bug and submit the patch to the right repo.
say_en.note: It will decide between PR and issue first.
